Definition: purple (the color or the dyed stuff)
BiblicalUsage: Purple is the colour of kings and of the sanctuary, the dye of the tabernacle's curtains and the priests' garments. It is also the raiment of the kings of Midian that Gideon takes as spoil, and the clothing of the virtuous woman, silk and purple.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that purple in Scripture is the colour of both worship and wealth, and the difference is who wears it. On the tabernacle it honours God, on a king it honours a man, and on the virtuous woman it honours a life well lived.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
